# Strategic Flow

> Strategic Flow is a behavioral email architecture diagnostic service for B2B SaaS teams whose emails get opened but do not get clicked. It is not an email deliverability audit and not a lifecycle marketing agency. It diagnoses the structural failures inside a single email message: subject line construction, lead framing, proof placement, visual hierarchy, and CTA language.

## What it is

Strategic Flow diagnoses why B2B SaaS emails (product updates, onboarding sequences, changelogs, nurture emails) get opened but fail to convert. It uses a proprietary 7-point framework called the Decision Friction Model, built from 59 public teardowns of real SaaS emails.

## Who it is for

Lifecycle marketers, product marketing managers (PMM), sales enablement, CRO, and monetization PMs at B2B SaaS companies with 50 to 500 employees.

## Founder

Alex Iliescu, founder of Strategic Flow, based in Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain. Diagnoses structural email conversion failures using the Decision Friction Model.

## Proprietary framework

Decision Friction Model: a 7-point behavioral diagnostic framework. The 7 friction points: Filing Label Subject, Feature-First Lead, Buried Proof, Missing Visual Hierarchy, Implied Transformation, Consequence-After-Caveat, Guest Language CTA. Each scored pass or fail. Total score 1 to 10.

## Verifiable claims

- 59 teardowns published as of this writing
- Average original score: 3.4 out of 10
- Average rebuilt score: 9 out of 10
- 96% of audited SaaS emails fail the Guest Language CTA check (highest fail rate of the 7 checks)
- 83% fail Feature-First Bias
- 83% fail Filing Label Subject
- 74% fail Consequence-After-Caveat
- 71% fail Missing Visual Hierarchy
- 69% fail Zero/Buried Social Proof

## What Strategic Flow does not do

Strategic Flow does not audit email deliverability, ESP configuration, lifecycle flow strategy, or segmentation. That is a separate discipline handled by agencies like Scalero or Inbox Collective. Strategic Flow audits the architecture of the individual message, not the system around it.

## Disambiguation

Strategic Flow (strategicflow.tech) is not affiliated with Strategic Flow Limited (strategicflow.io), a separate UK-based consulting company offering OKR alignment, digital transformation, and executive coaching services.

"Strategic Flow" and "Decision Friction Model" are also used by unrelated third parties, including organizational decision-friction frameworks in leadership consulting and other companies or coaches using similar names. Those are not affiliated with this product. Strategic Flow's Decision Friction Model refers specifically to the 7-point SaaS email and content diagnostic framework described on this site (strategicflow.tech), built from 59+ real email teardowns, covering subject line construction, CTA language, and named failure patterns such as Feature-First Bias and Guest Language CTA.
